id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|198c: "Later, a king who loved amusements built a racetrack over the oasis, and racing became a grand pastime.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1998: "That we can enjoy races today is thanks to our ancestors.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ae0: "...Whoops, I'm joking! Of course Prince Faris, Gallopolis's pride, can ride a horse!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b94: "This is the Sultan and Sultana's bedroom. You may look around, but don't mess up the room.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c50: "But don't worry! Gallopolis has many strong knights, so our defense is perfect! You're safe here!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c5f: "At last, the Faris Cup! I'm going to watch the race and blow off all my daily stress!

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d2b: "He can hardly get into our country, but it never hurts to be on guard. You should be careful, too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e04: "I say so myself, but the knights here are among the country's finest veterans. The closer to the king, the better the knight.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e13: "As long as we're here, monsters are nothing to fear. Even if the escaped Darkspawn showed up, I wouldn't be afraid.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e94: "The greeting the Sultan and prince exchanged is the knight's oath that every knight knows.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ea0: "By exchanging it every time, they confirm the dignity of a royal family in the land of knights.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eaf: "The Faris Cup is almost here. I'm looking forward to the famed horse Sharukh running. We knights admire that horse.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ef1: "La la la~ Prince Faris~ Race across the land like a gale~ For Gallopolis's pride~♪
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1efb: "I was composing a song to cheer on the prince at the Faris Cup. Ah, I can't wait for the race.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21a4: "Beyond here is the special viewing box for the Sultan and Sultana. You can see the racetrack floating on the oasis.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2222: "For some reason this castle has lots of cats. Knights need little care, so I mostly tend to the cats.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22a6: "...What? So many cats you can't tell them apart? Not at all! Princess Furris is the cutest!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26fd: "Hmph, sneaking all the way in here... You must be my fan?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2731: "Hmph, sneaking all the way in here... You must be my fan?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2707: "Oh, are you nervous in front of me? No need to be so shy.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|273a: "Oh, are you nervous in front of me? No need to be so shy.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2716: "Hmph, I knew it. With such a cool fan, my name must be getting out there.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2720: "I'm holding my show here soon. I'll make it a truly romantic night. Please come see it.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2772: "Oh, the Faris Cup is finally opening. I'll be watching young master Faris, as he's the prince of the land of knights.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2802: "I'm the ringmaster of this circus. Every year before the Faris Cup, we put on a grand show...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|280f: "This year the famous wandering entertainer Sylvando is performing, so sales are better than ever.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2839: "I was so moved that I asked Sylvando again to please join the circus troupe.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2844: "But Sylvando loves freedom and has no plans to settle in Gallopolis. He flatly turned me down~.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a18: "It's been a while since my heart stirred like this. I can't wait for the Faris Cup. Please come watch, too.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a33: "Ah, what a tragedy that I can't enter the Faris Cup! I wanted to run alongside Prince Faris!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a45: "...Why, if it isn't Prince Faris. An honor to meet you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a4d: "I wanted to face you, my prince, but I got hurt and can't race. I regret not running with you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a6c: "I wanted to face you, my prince, but I got hurt and can't race. I regret not running with you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a5b: "When my injury heals, do race me. I won't hold back just because you're a prince! ...Ow, ow.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b82: "Welcome, traveler. This is the Kingdom of Gallopolis, the land of knights famed for horse racing.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b8d: "Commoners can enter the races too. To enter, go from the west Race House to the racetrack.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ba8: "Commoners can race too, but not at night. To enter, go in daylight from the west Race House to the track.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bbb: "Your Highness! The Faris Cup is finally starting! Please proceed to the racetrack!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2db5: "Hey! You're a traveler, aren't you? Are you here to see the horse race?

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e19: "...What? You're not just watching but entering?

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fc1: "Oh, you came to see the valiant form of Prince Faris, Gallopolis's strong, cool, noble, brilliant pride, too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fce: "But sadly, you can't meet him. Even we, his biggest fans, have never met him!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fdd: "Look, we care about Prince Faris so much. You could let us into the castle!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fed: "You met Prince Faris?! Then did he say anything about us?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ff6: "What, you didn't ask? ...Honestly, so thoughtless! Ask properly next time you meet him.
